cases.symptom: Project roles can degrade into static prompt files with no executable learning loop.
cases.rootCause: Agent identity, runtime state, verification and durable lessons were not bound together.
cases.rule: Every project agent must be executable through the Steerion agent runtime, preload verified lessons, enforce a 10 minute ceiling and require independent verification for material builder outcomes.

cases.symptom: Static agent definitions can exist without executable runtime, GitHub discovery, independent verification, or persistent learning.
cases.rootCause: Agent profile, runtime, evidence, verifier, and memory were not previously bound as one contract.
cases.rule: Every repository agent must have a GitHub custom-agent profile and executable learning runtime; verified material outcomes require an independent verifier before durable learning.
